desc: 深黑撞焦糖橙的吧台视觉，从白底主图到多风味选购与空白信任收口
name: 吧台调饮风味糖浆多用途款

shots.intent: 搜索列表第一眼：细高玻璃瓶整支直立居中，一眼看清瓶型与浆色
主图一秒法则：深黑板底加焦糖橙滴落带，一秒传达专业吧台调饮定位
shots.textZone: right 40% charcoal field with one short headline line 「{selling_point_1}」 and one blank rounded badge carrying 「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 把浓缩浆的可变成品直观化，让买家一眼想像出杯中的颜色与生意
承接买家翻看瓶背信息的习惯，用空表格与空印章位保留规格说明结构
用挂壁拉丝的黏稠质感证明浓缩与溶解度，替代任何口说无凭的浓度主张
把产品放进专业吧台语境，暗示浓度足够驾驭热饮与奶类
同型瓶一排不同色带，让买家一次看完可选风味并挑走自己那支
一次展示热饮冰饮气泡与甜品多种落点，把使用面从咖啡扩到全部场景
以五枚同族线性徽章加空印章的结构收口，把信任位留给买家用真实资料填
shots.textZone: five short blank label lines under the badge discs carrying only 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」, 「{callout_4}」 and 「{callout_5}」

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white studio stage #FFFFFF for packshots, deep charcoal matte board #191614 for the graphic screens with a glossy caramel-orange #F08A16 pour band, lime-washed teal wall #7FB6BD and warm dark counter #241E1A for scenes
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin-line glyphs centred inside solid caramel-orange #F08A16 discs, outline only, no letters, no digits, no certification or religious seals
style.lightingSystem: neutral high-key studio light, large front-left softbox key with a fill card, thin sweeping rim travelling along the glass shoulder, soft honest contact shadows, never harsh or dramatic
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium barista-syrup gastronomy visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white stage #FFFFFF, deep charcoal board #191614, caramel-orange accent #F08A16 and indigo syrup blue #1D3C8C; neutral high-key studio lighting with a large front-left softbox key, fill card, thin sweeping rim along the glass shoulder and soft honest contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif in one family; single-weight thin-line glyphs inside solid caramel-orange discs only; tall slim bottle always upright, glossy and at a stable slight 3/4 or straight-on hero angle with constant scale; every label panel, badge, seal, table cell and colour strip stays blank and unprinted; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no printed numbers, units, flavour names or nutrition values anywhere
style.presentationRules: tall slim bottle kept upright, glossy and unclipped at a stable slight 3/4 or straight-on hero angle with constant scale; finished drinks read as food, never as plastic; every label panel, badge, seal, table cell and colour strip stays blank and unprinted
style.surfaceSystem: whitewashed timber table #E6DED5, pale limestone ledge #F1EDE7, dark timber serving tray #3A2F27, charcoal slate #1C1917
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one family only, one short headline plus five short label lines maximum, all wording carried by placeholders
